Apple authorized reseller in the Philippines. Where the Mac mini is purchased per venue. PH has no official Apple Certified Refurbished store, so new M4/M5 from here is effectively the only Mac mini procurement path — don't plan a cost-down around used M2s.

iPads and Apple TVs may also be sourced here or via Apple Business (business.apple.com) for volume pricing and ABM enrollment tokens.
